_comment: Permissions for the Claude Skills Toolkit (github.com/LunarCommand/claude-skills).
Copy to <project>/.claude/settings.json, or merge into ~/.claude/settings.json — it
covers this toolkit and nothing else, so either scope is reasonable. Without it, every
bundled script prompts on each call, which reads as the skill being broken.
Scripts are approved by BARE NAME, never by path: bin/ reaches the Bash tool's PATH
through the skill's .claude-plugin/plugin.json. A bare name failing with 'command not
found' means that manifest is missing, not that the rule is wrong.
The ask list is deliberate, not leftover: the git operations the recommended workflow
confirms first, plus the destructive ones adversarial-review's own instructions forbid.
